question: Which of the following instruments is used for measuring electrical resistance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ohmmeter**__.

__
 
• An **ohmmeter** is used for measuring** electrical resistance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• When an electric current flows through a bulb or any conductor, the conductor offers some **obstruction** to the current and this obstruction is known as **electrical resistance **and is denoted by** R**.
 
• Every material has an electrical resistance and this is the reason why conductors give out **heat** when current passes through it. 
 
 
• **Formula: **R = V/IVIVIVI** **
 
• **SI unit: **Ohms
 
• **Symbol: **Ω
 
• **Measuring instruments: **Ohmmeter
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
